verdict.rationale: Lindy's own docs say it is driven by natural-language delegation. Users describe a process once and Lindy picks the right skill per request, handles work in Slack DMs, takes requests over iMessage/SMS, and writes daily briefs on whatever you prompt it to cover. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe the process once, and from then on Lindy picks the right skill whenever a request calls for it. You never have to remember to invoke one.
Zero setup. Lindy handles email, meetings, and scheduling right in your DMs.
Lindy works over both iMessage and SMS, so you can delegate to your AI assistant right from your phone.
Lindy can send you a daily brief on anything you prompt it to cover. Tell it exactly what you want
